title: My LightCarbon LCR017D review and ordering experience. Crazy value for money.

takeaways.text: 30 mm Pirelli P Zero Race tires fit with visible room around them.
The Richey-style aero seatpost slipped and creaked until he used carbon assembly paste; brake mounts, axle faces and the T47 shell arrived properly faced with no paint issues.
With 105 Di2, Ninebelow 55 mm wheels of just over 1,400 g, carbon pedals and saddle, his bike weighs about 7.4 kg.
The front hose enters the fork on one side; crossing hoses to run the front brake on the other lever made the steering bind, so he kept the natural routing.
Frameset with custom logo paint cost US$782 (import tax extra), took about a month to arrive and was adequately padded; an endoscope check looked clean.

disclosure: Owner video; he bought the frameset directly from LightCarbon and no sponsorship is stated.
summary: A UK owner's size-52 LightCarbon LCR017-D with Shimano 105 Di2 after about 700 miles, including the ordering process.
